x: James, Tasker, Oliver and Robins were second in the handicap team race and our "A" Team with Sapcote, Bellchamber, McMullen and East were third in the handicap team race.

Despite being chased by Robins, of Essex Beagles, and Charlesworth, of Aylesford, Walker, in stylish manner, increased our lead to forty-three seconds and left Bill Lucas the comparatively easy task of staying out in front.

Eight miles was reached by Clayton in 70.36, closely followed by McGreechan, Wright and Checkley; 350 yards behind came Bidgood, Bellchambers, Shields and Rutland, and a further 200 yards Wakeley and Readman, closely followed by Sapcote, Sutton and Robins.
